verbatim_quote.original: fix the REALITY short-id quoting bug the new feed exposed
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Fix the REALITY short-id quoting bug that the new feed exposed.

extracted_decision.summary: Force double-quoted YAML scalars for REALITY public-key/short-id so Go-YAML cannot misread hex values such as 2e00 as a float.
extracted_decision.rationale: PyYAML emits 2e00 unquoted; Go-YAML parses it as float 2.0 and mihomo rejects the config.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Quoted scalars look unusual but are semantically required for mihomo.
